title: Wedding page details
description: Everything the wedding page shows. Edit wedding.json; index.html reads it. See README.md.

text.description: Plain text, or the same text in English / Hindi / Bengali. If a language is missing, English is shown.

url.description: A full web link starting with https://

couple.description: The two first names, in the order they appear ("Sushmit & Manaswita"). The first gets the gold thread, the second the red thread.

blessing.description: Line above the names, e.g. "॥ श्री गणेशाय नमः ॥". Use "" to hide it.

hashtag.description: Wedding hashtag, e.g. "#SushmitWedsManaswita". Use "" to hide it.

city.description: Shown under the dates, e.g. "Jamshedpur & Agartala".

welcome.description: Optional short welcome line under the arch. Use "" to hide it.

siteUrl.description: The live page link. Used for the QR code, WhatsApp sharing and calendar entries.

photoAlbumUrl.description: Shared photo album link (Google Photos → Share → Create link).

shareMessage.description: WhatsApp message. {url} is replaced with the page link.

parents.description: The "With the blessings of" section. Leave the list empty to hide it.

contacts.description: People guests can call or WhatsApp.

events.description: The functions. They are shown in date order automatically. The one named Wedding / Vivah / Shaadi gets the gathbandhan knot.

name.description: e.g. "Haldi". The English name also picks the card's little drawing (haldi, mehendi, sangeet, wedding, reception).

end.description: Optional end time. Leave out to show "7:00 PM onwards" (calendar entries then last 4 hours). After midnight is fine, e.g. "00:30".

mapsUrl.description: Google Maps link for the Directions button, e.g. https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=22.81,86.16

note.description: Short italic note on the card.

palette.description: Colour dots shown with the dress code. [] hides them.

motif.description: Optional: force the card's drawing instead of guessing from the name.
